name: Computer Science & Engineering Practice Mock - Practice Test 1

questions.question: What is the time complexity of searching in a balanced Binary Search Tree?
questions.hint: Balanced trees restrict height to log2(n) levels, limiting search paths.

questions.question: Which data structure works on the LIFO principle?
questions.hint: Stacks push/pop from the same end (Last-In First-Out).

questions.question: The process of dividing physical memory into fixed-size blocks is:
questions.hint: Paging slices RAM into frames and virtual space into pages.

questions.question: A deadlock can be prevented by breaking which condition?
options: Mutual exclusion / Hold and wait / No preemption / Circular wait
questions.hint: Eliminating any of the four Coffman conditions prevents deadlocks.

questions.question: In DBMS, the ACID property 'I' stands for:
questions.hint: Isolation guarantees concurrent transactions run without cross interference.

questions.question: Which SQL statement is used to remove a table schema and all its rows?
questions.hint: DROP TABLE permanently deletes schema, indices, constraints, and data.

questions.question: What is the default port number for HTTP?
questions.hint: Unsecured HTTP traffic defaults to TCP/IP port 80.

questions.question: Which protocol is used to map an IP address to a MAC address?
questions.hint: Address Resolution Protocol (ARP) translates layer-3 IPs to layer-2 physical MACs.

questions.question: The network topology in which all nodes are connected to a central hub is:
questions.hint: Star networks use point-to-point lines to a central switch/hub.

questions.question: Which algorithm is used for finding shortest paths in a weighted graph?
questions.hint: Dijkstra solves single-source shortest path values on positive weights.

questions.question: The compiler phase that checks syntax rules is:
questions.hint: Parsers construct parse trees from tokens to validate grammatical correctness.

questions.question: What is the size of an IPv4 address?
questions.hint: IPv4 uses 4-byte (32-bit) addresses, whereas IPv6 uses 128-bit addresses.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT an OOP concept?
questions.hint: Compilation is a build phase; OOP pillars are encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism, and abstraction.

questions.question: The logic gate equivalent to Boolean addition is:
questions.hint: OR gate yields 1 if either input is 1 (A + B).

questions.question: What is the time complexity of Quick Sort in the worst case?
questions.hint: Worst case (e.g. sorted arrays with bad pivot choices) degrades partition steps to O(n^2).
